primarySource.title: Kentucky Circuit Court Clerks' Manual, July 2026
sourceFacts: Section 34.19.1(1) directs the clerk, on receipt of AOC 275.18, to verify the signature, apply the FILED stamp, and complete the form notification section.

Section 34.19.1(2) instructs the clerk to serve copies of the notice by first-class mail per the distribution list if the movant has not already done so; this is clerk fallback service, not a clerk-only rule.
The section note says the respondent need not provide a KSP Expungement Certification with the motion. It does not prescribe or identify a separate certificate of service.
The AOC-275.18 notification block itself prints the distribution list (Court file, Petitioner, Respondent); the held source set supplies no separate service-certificate form.

proposedTreatment: Retain service_instructions as a required component and retain all primary-filing, notice, distribution, and service coverage.
Remove only the unsupported statement that the packet provides a certificate; do not remove the service requirement or fallback rule.
Point manualCompletionItems[1] to the delivered AOC-275.18 notification-of-expungement-hearing section and its printed Copies to distribution list.

Do not author a blank or completed certificate from inference; any certificate adoption would require a separate source-backed owner/counsel decision.
